title: Consumer profile
description: The values a consumer (viewer, simulator, game runtime, BIM tool, archive) publishes so that authors and agents can build to it. Every parameter has a default in profiles/default.json; a profile may omit any of them. Rules in rules.json name the parameters they use.

horizontalAxes.description: which horizontal directions +X and +Y mean to this consumer (Z is up, right-handed)

levelOffsetMetres.description: height, in the consumer's global frame, of the file's local z = 0; declared positions in the optional extensions add it

placement.description: final: the consumer applies no offset or rotation to the file; the file is authored in its final placement frame

allowed.description: IFC schema identifiers the consumer accepts

maxFileMegabytes.description: hard size cap of one IFC file, in megabytes

maxVertices.description: hard cap on mesh vertices in one file

maxTriangles.description: hard cap on triangles in one file

recommendedFileMegabytes.description: size above which a file is slow to load and review

recommendedTriangles.description: triangle count above which load and display cost grows noticeably

maxDistinctColours.description: number of distinct (class, colour, opacity) combinations above which the palette is too large to manage

maxItemTriangles.description: triangles of one ordinary library item

singleLineEntities.description: true when the consumer's reader needs every STEP entity on one line

roomIdMaxLength.description: longest allowed room identifier, in characters

roomIdPattern.description: regular expression a room identifier must match

entityNumberStart.description: first entity number a delivery may use, so that files from several authors can be merged without clashes; null means no assigned range

occupants.description: allowed values of the room Occupant property; null means any value

circulationPrefix.description: text a Function value must start with for corridors and other circulation; null means no convention

doorMinClearHeightMetres.description: smallest clear height of a doorway

doorMinClearWidthMetres.description: smallest clear width of a doorway

doorwayProbeHeightsMetres.description: heights above the sill at which the doorway centre line must be free of solid geometry

stairRiserLimitMetres.description: largest riser height of a stair

rampMaxSlope.description: largest slope of a walked ramp, as rise over run (0.0833 is 1:12)

maxCurveSegmentsPerCircle.description: segments per full circle above which tessellation is wasteful

stairHeadroomMetres.description: clear height required above every stair tread

roomOverlapToleranceMetres.description: largest thickness by which two rooms on one level may overlap (a wall)

baseSurfaces.description: floors the consumer supplies itself: rooms standing on them need no slab of their own

buildVolume.description: region all geometry must stay inside: {box:{min,max}} or {ellipse:{a,b,zmin,zmax}}, in the consumer's global frame

keepOut.description: regions geometry must stay out of: [{id,min,max}]

propertyNames.description: canonical declaration property name -> the name this consumer reads; use it to rename or to point at standard property names

ruleLevels.description: rule id -> required, recommended or off; overrides the level the rule has in rules.json

extensions.description: optional rule groups; each applies only when enabled

enabled.description: consumer places people or agents in rooms and walks them

standingClearanceMetres.description: free floor kept around furniture and fixed objects where a person can stand

freeCircleMetres.description: diameter of a free floor circle in every enclosed room

stepHeightMetres.description: height a walker steps over without noticing

nonSolidClasses.description: IFC classes the consumer treats as not solid

enabled.description: consumer turns declared fixtures into lights

lensNameSuffix.description: ending of the name of the emissive part

requiredProperties.description: properties every luminaire assembly must carry

positionToleranceMetres.description: largest distance between the declared light position and the emissive part, level offset applied

maxPerRoom.description: most fixtures per room, or null

enabled.description: consumer generates signs from declared boards

displayPixelsPerRadian.description: pixels per radian of the display, used for legibility

minCapitalPixels.description: smallest capital height in pixels for primary, secondary and tertiary text

readingDistanceMetres.description: smallest and largest accepted reading distance

enabled.description: consumer approximates furniture with a simple collider

mode.description: box: one axis-aligned box per furniture element; mesh: exact triangles

enabled.description: consumer supplies terrain from its own source and wants a derived, read-only terrain patch in the file

crsName.description: name of the consumer's site coordinate reference system, written as the IfcProjectedCRS name; it need not be a registry code; null accepts any non-empty name

patchFormat.description: form of the height patch the consumer's terrain source delivers

maxErrorBoundMetres.description: largest vertical difference allowed between the terrain triangles and the source samples

footprintMarginMetres.description: margin by which the terrain patch must extend beyond the building footprint in plan

clearingMarginMetres.description: margin round the footprint in which the terrain source clears vegetation

grading.description: grading rule sent to the terrain source: maxCutFillSlope is the steepest cut or fill slope as horizontal:vertical text, for example 1:2

seaLevelMetres.description: height of sea level in the consumer's vertical datum; terrain below it is seabed

floatToleranceMetres.description: how far the lowest finished floor may stand above the terrain at every footprint point before the building counts as floating

buryToleranceMetres.description: how far the lowest finished floor may stand below the terrain at every footprint point before the building counts as buried

siteElevationToleranceMetres.description: largest difference between IfcSite.RefElevation and the terrain height at the building origin

maxTriangles.description: most triangles in the terrain element

maxPatchSamples.description: most samples read from one height patch; a larger patch is refused before it is loaded

sizesPixels.description: allowed texture map sizes in pixels (square)

maps.description: map file names a set must contain, without extension

normalConvention.description: +Y: green channel points up (OpenGL style); -Y: green points down (DirectX style)

tintModes.description: allowed values of tintMode in set.json

maxPackageMegabytes.description: upload size cap of a whole package, or null

requireProvenance.description: every asset needs a provenance entry

requireLicence.description: every asset and the package need a licence

submission.description: limits and requirements for deliveries offered by outside contributors as pull requests (guide 4, section 8; tools/check_submission.py); a consumer that accepts no submissions can ignore the group

maxFiles.description: most files in one delivery folder

maxFileBytes.description: largest single file in a delivery, in bytes

maxDeliveryBytes.description: largest total size of a delivery folder, in bytes

maxPathLength.description: longest relative path inside a delivery, in characters

allowedExtensions.description: file name endings allowed in a delivery, lower case, without the dot; anything else (programs, scripts, archives) is refused

allowedLicences.description: licence identifiers a submitter may offer the delivery under

ingestMaxComponents.description: most component assets one delivery may be split into by tools/ingest.py

ingestMaxSeconds.description: time limit of one tools/ingest.py run, in seconds

maxImagePixels.description: most pixels (width times height) of one PNG or JPEG image in a delivery; protects reviewers and ingest from decompression bombs
